title: AutoRedClaw: Automated Red-Teaming for Claw-Style Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.27244v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent systems are shifting from task-scoped tool-use agents to persistent, personalized assistants such as OpenClaw. These claw-style agents maintain configuration files (e.g., AGENTS.md), long-term memory, and reusable skills. Once poisoned, this persistent state is repeatedly reloaded into the agent's context, creating persistent threats across tasks and sessions. Existing security evaluation systems struggle to evaluate these complex claw-style systems since they rely heavily on manually constructed test cases and environments, which limits their scale and coverage; in addition, these manually designed cases quickly become outdated as agents evolve, and their evaluation settings leave a gap with how claw-style agents are deployed in practice. translated_title: AutoRedClaw：面向“爪式”智能体的自动化红队测试
translated_abstract: 智能体系统正在从限定任务范围的工具使用型智能体，转变为持久化、个性化的助手（如OpenClaw）。这类“爪式”智能体维护着配置文件（如AGENTS.md）、长期记忆和可复用技能。一旦被投毒，这些持久化状态会被反复重新加载到智能体的上下文中，从而在跨任务、跨会话层面形成持续性威胁。现有安全评估系统难以评估这类复杂的爪式系统，因为它们严重依赖人工构建的测试用例和环境，这限制了评估的规模与覆盖面；此外，这些人工设计的用例随着智能体的演进很快就会过时，且其评估设置与爪式智能体在实践中的部署方式之间存在差距。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AutoRedClaw——一个自动化红队测试框架，它能够生成端到端的攻击以及执行这些攻击所需的环境。AutoRedClaw结合了一种（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了AutoRedClaw，一个能自动生成端到端攻击及其配套执行环境的红队测试框架，用于评估OpenClaw等持久化“爪式”智能体，解决了现有依赖人工构建用例的安全评估方法规模小、易过时、与实际部署脱节的问题。
en_tdlr: AutoRedClaw is an automated red-teaming framework that generates end-to-end attacks along with the environments needed to execute them, enabling scalable security evaluation of persistent claw-style agents like OpenClaw beyond manually constructed test cases.
